precepts.why:
The prince of Tyrus says, “I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas”. Right now the Israelis are the chief ones that say that, but all Edom puts itself there, because of that white false image: they are literally saying, I am God, God is white, all the angels are white, all the prophets are white. In the midst of the seas means in the midst of all the nations. “yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God”: though you operate in the earth like you control everything, it was only given into your hand for a dispensation of time, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

Ezekiel goes on: “With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches”. They figured out how to manipulate all these laws to get what they want: Trump is going to get that oil and that land in Venezuela. We try to say they are dumb, but we are the ones made dumb, learning from them, because most of us don't have the scriptures.

That traffic goes into slavery, trading the souls of men, as well as all the commerce and merchandise. Ezekiel 27:13 shows that the traffic chiefly deals with people: “Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.” They traded the persons of men: slavery, us. And the vessels of brass are all the other things, the oils, the jewels and the precious metals. Revelation 18 lists the same: all the gold and precious things, and then the souls of men.

So the riches that lifted up the prince's heart were built by trading our people, and the same system still drains Africa and Latin America alike. It is only a failure if you are on the side being oppressed; for that man of sin, Babylon the Great, it is an absolute success. That is why the nations will lament when judgment comes on Babylon: they got rich off the systems America put in place.

points: Take up a lamentation for Tyrus, situate at the entry of the sea, a merchant of the people for many isles: O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty. Because of their wisdom. This is not talking about modern-day Lebanon; this is talking about America.
The word of the Most High came again unto Ezekiel, telling him to take up a lamentation for Tyrus, the city situated at the entry of the sea and a merchant of the people for many isles.
Tyrus had said, I am of perfect beauty; her borders were in the midst of the seas, and her builders had perfected her beauty.

Her builders made all her ship boards of fir trees from Senir, took cedars from Lebanon to make masts, and made her oars of the oaks of Bashan, her benches of ivory, and her sails of fine linen from Egypt.

The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were her mariners, her wise men were her pilots, and the men of Persia, Lud, and Phut were in her army, hanging their shields and helmets in her to set forth her comeliness.

Tarshish, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, Togarmah, Dedan, Syria, Judah and the land of Israel, Damascus, Dan, Arabia, Kedar, Sheba, and many more traded in her fairs with silver, iron, tin, lead, brass, horses, ivory, ebony, emeralds, purple, fine linen, wheat, honey, oil, wine, wool, spices, precious stones, gold, and rich apparel.
By reason of the multitude of all her riches she was replenished and made very glorious in the midst of the sea, the ships of Tarshish singing of her in her market.

Her rowers brought her into great waters, but the east wind broke her in the midst of the seas; her riches, her merchandise, her mariners, and all her company fell into the midst of the seas in the day of her ruin.

The pilots and mariners cry bitterly, cast dust on their heads, make themselves bald, and take up a lamentation, asking what city is like Tyrus, destroyed in the midst of the sea; the merchants hiss at her, and she is made a terror and shall never be any more.
